blocks.text: 🪝 Bloomberg Launches Electronic Trading Platform for Indian Government Bonds (IGBs). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Connects FPIs directly to RBI's NDS-OM matching system for T+1 gilt settlement.
Platform Connectivity: Terminal directly connected to Negotiated Dealing System-Order Matching (NDS-OM).
Settlement Guarantee: T+1 trades guaranteed by Clearing Corporation of India Limited (CCIL).
NDS-OM settlement cycle (T+1) vs stock market equities (T+1).
